d: While in New Jersey, Chef Ramsay visits Flamango's, an outdated eatery in need of help. Ramsay suggests a major overhaul, but the owner thinks it's best to simply shut down the restaurant.

st: Tom Hanks Eats His Last Meal
d: Tom Hanks talks about getting out of your comfort zone and religion over an In-N-Out double double and a Diet Dr. Pepper.
Martha shares three renowned French cookies: papillons (elephant ears), French meringues in a rainbow of colors and flavors, and buttery Bretons
Martha shows how to transform one basic recipe into three stunning celebration cakes: naked berry chiffon cake, caramel chiffon cake, and woodland stump cake
Martha shows how five-ingredient pate a choux is the foundation for many recipes: pate a choux swans swimming in a chocolate pond, coconut eclairs, and pink croquembouche
Martha takes your baking skills to the next level with boulangerie bread recipes: golden-brown artisan boule, onion and leek focaccia, and multi-layered brioche feuilletee
Martha demonstrates how to make special occasion cookies: vanilla and chocolate shortbread swirls, embellished wreaths with sugared flowers, and cherry blossom cookies
Martha shares meringue desserts: meringue wreath with jewel-like sugared berries, chocolate angel food cake with milk chocolate frosting, and almond dacquoise bombers
Dumplings are a mainstay in nearly every cuisine around the world. Watch Martha make Italian dumplings gnocchi and gnudi  plus, her family recipe for Polish pierogi
Whole grains are an integral part of a healthy lifestyle. Martha provides an overview of grains and the different cooking methods for polenta, bulgur, quinoa, and farro
Martha discusses two of the oldest preserving techniques, confit and salting, and how to use them at home: duck confit, tomato confit, and gravlax, a cured salmon appetizer
Martha and chef Cesare Casella shed light on legumes, exploring the varieties and how to cook them using three different methods: stovetop, oven, and pressure cooker
